# ScramLogger

*Common*

Script logger, available to every script as the global `console`, like in JavaScript. Messages go to the Scram log of the side the script runs on, in the `logs/scram` folder of the game:

`server-.log` for server scripts, `client-.log` for client scripts. They also appear in the script console: of the player for client scripts, of operators for server scripts. Errors of client scripts are also sent to the server, which keeps them in `client--.log`. Each line has the time, the level, the calling script with its line, and the message.

```js
console.log("Arena started");
console.warn("Not enough players: " + count);
console.error("Spawn point is missing");
```

## Methods

### log {#log}

::: member

Writes an informational message, like [`info`](#info).

```js
console.log("Player joined: " + c.getPlayer().getName());
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | message text. |

:::

### info {#info}

::: member

Writes an informational message.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | message text. |

:::

### warn {#warn}

::: member

Writes a warning.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | message text. |

:::

### warn {#warn-2}

::: member

Writes a warning and optionally shows it as a notification in the Scram UI: to the player for client scripts, to operators for server scripts.

```js
console.warn("Arena config is missing, using defaults", true);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | message text. |
| `notify` | [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) | `true` to also show the notification. |

:::

### error {#error}

::: member

Writes an error. It is not reported to the server: only script failures are.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | message text. |

:::
